rows.text_en: Korea Forest Service ( Innovation Administration Division ), 042-482-4232
Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 산림청과 그 소속기관에 두는 보조기관ㆍ보좌기관의 직급 및 직급별 정원, 「정부조직법」 제2조제3항 및 제5항에 따라 기획조정관ㆍ국장 밑에 두는 보조기관과 이에 상당하는 보좌기관의 설치 및 사무분장 등 「산림청과 그 소속기관 직제」에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 정함을 목적으로 한다. <개정 2008. 3. 3.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Organizational Structure of the Korea Forest Service and Its Affiliated Agencies” and matters necessary for its implementation , including the ranks and staffing quotas for auxiliary and advisory agencies within the Korea Forest Service and its affiliated agencies, the establishment and division of duties of auxiliary agencies and equivalent advisory agencies placed under the Director General for Planning and Coordination and Bureau Chiefs pursuant to Article 2, Paragraphs 3 and 5 of the Government Organization Act .<Amended Mar. 3, 2008>
Chapter 2 Korea Forest Service

rows.source_ko: 제2조(차장) 차장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다. <개정 2013. 12. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Deputy Commissioner) The Deputy Commissioner shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A. <Amended Dec. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(대변인) 대변인은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Spokesperson) The Spokesperson shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>
[Wholly Amended Mar. 3, 2008]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(기획조정관) ① 기획조정관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Director General of Planning and Coordination) ① The Director General of Planning and Coordination shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008>

rows.source_ko: ② 기획조정관 밑에 기획재정담당관ㆍ혁신행정담당관ㆍ법무감사담당관ㆍ산림디지털담당관 및 산림빅데이터팀장을 두되, 각 담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ임업사무관ㆍ전산사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2009. 4. 30., 2013. 9. 26., 2017. 8. 11., 2023. 1. 13., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② Under the Director General of Planning and Coordination, there shall be a Planning and Finance Officer, an Innovation Administration Officer, a Legal Affairs and Audit Officer, a Forestry Digital Officer, and a Forestry Big Data Team Leader; wherein each Officer shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, a Science and Technology Secretary, or a Secretary, and each Team Leader shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Secretary, a Secretary, a Forestry Officer, a Computer Science Officer, or an Administrative Officer. <Amended Apr. 30, 2009; Sep. 26, 2013; Aug. 11, 2017; Jan. 13, 2023; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 기획재정담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정관을 보좌한다. <개정 2009. 4. 30., 2010. 10. 22., 2013. 9. 26.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Director of Planning and Finance assists the Director General of Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters. <Amended Apr. 30, 2009; Oct. 22, 2010; Sep. 26, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. 각종 정책과 계획의 수립ㆍ종합 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Formulation, synthesis, and coordination of various policies and plans
2. Establishment of guidelines, consolidation, and coordination of major work plans
3. Overall management of policy coordination with other ministries
4. Coordination and Management of Budget Formulation and Execution
5. Operation of Digital Budget and Accounting System
6. Performance Management and Evaluation of Financial Projects
7. Overall management and coordination of administrative collaboration-related tasks
8. Overall management of National Assembly-related affairs

rows.source_ko: 9. 그 밖에 관내 다른 담당관의 소관에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other officials within the jurisdiction

④ The Director of Innovation Administration assists the Director General of Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters. <Amended Apr. 30, 2009; Oct. 22, 2010; Sep. 26, 2013; Aug. 11, 2017; Mar. 30, 2018>
1. Overall management and coordination of administrative innovation tasks

rows.source_ko: 1의2. 정부혁신 관련 과제의 발굴ㆍ선정, 추진상황 확인ㆍ점검 및 성과 관리
rows.text_en: 1-2. Identification and selection of government innovation-related tasks, verification and monitoring of implementation status, and performance management

rows.source_ko: 2. 주요정책과제 등에 대한 자체평가 및 정부업무 평가 총괄
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management of self-evaluations on major policy tasks, etc., and government performance evaluations
3. Overall management, coordination, and support of performance management tasks

rows.source_ko: 4. 조직진단 및 평가를 통한 조직과 정원의 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Management of Organization and Staffing through Organizational Diagnosis and Evaluation
5. Management of Regulations on Division of Duties and Delegation of Authority Regulations
6. Management of Operational Status of Internal Committees

rows.source_ko: 7. 청 내 공공기관, 기업, 단체 등과의 행정협업 관련 업무의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 7. Overall management and coordination of administrative collaboration tasks within the Agency involving public institutions, companies, organizations, etc.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 법무감사담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정관을 보좌한다. <개정 2009. 4. 30., 2010. 10. 22., 2022. 7. 22.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Legal Affairs and Audit Officer assists the Director General of Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters. <Amended Apr. 30, 2009; Oct. 22, 2010; Jul. 22, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 행정제도 및 민원(국민제안을 포함한다) 관련 제도 개선계획의 수립ㆍ집행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and execution of plans for improving administrative systems and civil complaints (including citizen proposals)

rows.source_ko: 1의2. 청원제도의 운영 및 적극행정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1-2. Matters concerning the operation of the petition system and proactive administration
2. Drafting and Review of Proposed Laws and Regulations
3. Overall management of litigation affairs
4. Administrative Appeals Affairs
5. Compilation and publication of the Code of Laws

rows.source_ko: 6. 청내 규제개혁 및 정비에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning regulatory reform and streamlining within the Agency

rows.source_ko: 7. 소속 공공기관의 설립인가 및 정관승인에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the authorization of establishment and approval of articles of incorporation of affiliated public institutions
8. Official discipline and investigation affairs

rows.source_ko: 9. 산림청과 그 소속기관 및 산하단체(소속 공공기관을 포함한다)에 대한 감사
rows.text_en: 9. Audits of the Korea Forest Service and its affiliated agencies and subordinate organizations (including affiliated public institutions)

rows.source_ko: 10. 소속 공무원의 재산등록ㆍ선물신고 및 취업제한에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning property registration, gift reporting, and employment restrictions of affiliated public officials
11. Investigation and Handling of Complaints and Misconduct

rows.source_ko: 12. 다른 기관에 의한 산림청 및 소속기관에 대한 감사결과의 처리
rows.text_en: 12. Handling of audit results regarding the Korea Forest Service and its affiliated agencies by other agencies

rows.source_ko: 13. 감사에 관한 통계의 유지 및 비위사항에 관한 요인 분석
rows.text_en: 13. Maintenance of Audit Statistics and Factor Analysis Regarding Misconduct
13-2. Establishment and Implementation of Comprehensive Anti-Corruption Measures within the Agency

rows.source_ko: 14. 그 밖에 청장이 감사에 관하여 지시한 사항의 처리
rows.text_en: 14. Handling of other matters instructed by the Commissioner regarding the audit

⑥ The Forest Digital Affairs Officer assists the Director General for Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters. <Amended Oct. 22, 2010; Nov. 30, 2015; Dec. 14, 2021; Jan. 13, 2023>
1. Establishment and overall coordination of forest informatization plans

rows.source_ko: 2. 산림정보자원 보호 및 관리 계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and implementation of plans for the protection and management of forest information resources
3. Development, Operation, and Management of Forest Information Systems
4. Development, Operation, and Management of the Forest Spatial Information System
6. Deleted <Jan. 13, 2023>
7. Establishment, Operation, and Management of Information Technology Architecture

rows.source_ko: 8. 사이버보안 관리 및 개인정보 보호에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning cybersecurity management and personal information protection

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 산림빅데이터팀장은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정관을 보좌한다. <신설 2023. 1. 13.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Forest Big Data Team assists the Director General of Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters. <Newly added Jan. 13, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 산림 관련 데이터ㆍ통계의 수집 총괄 및 분석 지원
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management of forest-related data and statistics, and support for analysis

rows.source_ko: 2. 산림 관련 데이터ㆍ통계의 품질 관리, 연계 및 공동활용
rows.text_en: 2. Quality management, linkage, and joint use of forest-related data and statistics

rows.source_ko: 3. 청 내 데이터기반행정 활성화를 위한 계획의 수립ㆍ추진
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and implementation of plans to revitalize data-based administration within the agency

rows.source_ko: 4. 산림 및 임업통계조사의 기획ㆍ실시 및 공표
rows.text_en: 4. Planning, Implementation, and Publication of Forest and Forestry Statistical Surveys
5. Publication of Forest and Forestry Statistical Data

rows.source_ko: 6. 청 내 공공데이터의 제공 및 이용 활성화에 관한 계획의 수립ㆍ추진 및 평가 등 총괄
rows.text_en: 6. Overall management of plans regarding the provision and promotion of the use of public data within the Agency, including establishment, implementation, and evaluation.
[Wholly Amended Mar. 3, 2008]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(국제산림협력관) ① 국제산림협력관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원 또는 임업연구관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2017. 1. 24., 2023. 7. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Director General for International Forestry Cooperation) ① The Director General for International Forestry Cooperation shall be appointed from among general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service or Forestry Research Officers, provided that the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. <Amended Jan. 24, 2017; Jul. 21, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 국제산림협력관 밑에 국제협력담당관ㆍ해외자원담당관 및 임업수출교역팀을 두며, 각 담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보하고, 팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ임업사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2015. 1. 6., 2017. 1. 24., 2022. 7. 22., 2023. 7. 21., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② Under the Director General for International Forestry Cooperation, an International Cooperation Officer, an Overseas Resources Officer, and a Forestry Export Trade Team shall be established; each Officer shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, a Secretary for Science and Technology, or a Secretary, and the Team Leader shall be appointed as a Secretary for Science and Technology, a Secretary, a Forestry Officer, or an Administrative Officer. <Amended Jan. 6, 2015; Jan. 24, 2017; Jul. 22, 2022; Jul. 21, 2023; Aug. 30, 2023>

③ The International Cooperation Officer assists the Director General for International Forestry Cooperation in the following matters. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Sep. 26, 2013; Jan. 24, 2017; Jan. 26, 2018; Jan. 22, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. 유엔기후변화협약(UNFCCC), 유엔사막화방지협약(UNCCD), 생물다양성협약(CBD) 등 산림분야 국제협약ㆍ국제기구 협상 총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management of negotiations for international agreements and organizations in the forestry sector, including the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD), and the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD).

rows.source_ko: 2. 국제산림협력 정책ㆍ협정과 국내 정책과의 연계에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the linkage between international forest cooperation policies and agreements and domestic policies

rows.source_ko: 3. 산림분야 국제기구ㆍ다자간 협정 제정ㆍ개정에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the establishment of international forestry organizations and conclusion or amendment of multilateral agreements in the forestry sector

rows.source_ko: 4. 산림분야 국제기구 협상ㆍ협력 및 국제 산림협력사업 개발 및 추진
rows.text_en: 4. Negotiation and cooperation with international organizations in the forestry sector and development and implementation of international forestry cooperation projects

rows.source_ko: 5. 국제산림협력 정책의 수립 및 국가 간의 산림협력 회의 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the establishment of international forest cooperation policies and the operation of inter-country forest cooperation meetings
6. Matters concerning support and cooperation with the Asian Forest Cooperation Organization (AFoCO)

rows.source_ko: 7. 산림분야 국제협약ㆍ국제기구의 부담금 및 국제기구 인력파견 조정ㆍ총괄
rows.text_en: 7. Coordination and overall management of contributions to international conventions and organizations in the forestry sector, as well as personnel dispatch to international organizations.
9. Deleted <July 22, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ④ 해외자원담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 국제산림협력관을 보좌한다. <개정 2013. 9. 26., 2017. 1. 24., 2019. 1. 22., 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Officer in Charge of Overseas Resources assists the Director General for International Forestry Cooperation in the following matters. <Amended Sep. 26, 2013; Jan. 24, 2017; Jan. 22, 2019; Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 해외산림자원개발 중장기 전략수립 및 정책개발에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the establishment of mid-to-long-term strategies and policy development for overseas forest resource development

rows.source_ko: 2. 해외산림자원개발 국가간 협정체결 및 대상지 확보에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the conclusion of inter-country agreements and securing of target sites for overseas forest resource development

rows.source_ko: 3. 해외산림자원개발을 위한 법ㆍ제도 개선에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the improvement of laws and systems for overseas forest resource development

rows.source_ko: 4. 해외산림자원개발을 위한 연구ㆍ조사와 투자지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning research, surveys, and investment support for overseas forest resource development

rows.source_ko: 5. 해외산림자원 확보를 위한 사업 추진에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the implementation of projects to secure overseas forest resources

rows.source_ko: 6. 국외산림탄소축적 증진 관련 법ㆍ제도 개선, 중장기 전략수립 및 정책개발에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the improvement of laws and systems, establishment of mid-to-long-term strategies, and policy development related to the promotion of overseas forest carbon sequestration
7. Implementation of Follow-up Measures for the UN Convention to Combat Desertification General Assembly

rows.source_ko: 8. 산림분야 공적개발원조(ODA) 관련 정책 개발 및 사업 추진
rows.text_en: 8. Development of policies and implementation of projects related to Official Development Assistance (ODA) in the forestry sector
9. Deleted <Jan. 6, 2015>
10. Deleted <Jan. 6, 2015>
11. Deleted <Jan. 6, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 임업수출교역팀장은 다음 사항에 관하여 국제산림협력관을 보좌한다. <신설 2015. 1. 6., 2017. 1. 24., 2023. 7. 21.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Forestry Export Trade Team assists the Director General for International Forestry Cooperation with respect to the following matters. <Newly added Jan. 6, 2015; Jan. 24, 2017; Jul. 21, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 임업분야 통상협상 대책수립ㆍ총괄 및 대응에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the establishment, overall management, and response to trade negotiations in the forestry sector

rows.source_ko: 2. 임업분야 통상관련 분쟁해결 및 비관세장벽 해소에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the resolution of trade-related disputes and the removal of non-tariff barriers in the forestry sector

rows.source_ko: 3. 임산물 시장접근물량 수입관리 및 관세제도의 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the import management of market access quotas for forest products and the operation of the customs system
4. Establishment and Implementation of Measures to Promote the Export of Forest Products

rows.source_ko: 5. 국내외 임업경제 동향 파악 및 수출입통계 분석
rows.text_en: 5. Identifying domestic and international forestry economic trends and analyzing import and export statistics

rows.source_ko: 6. 남북 산림분야 협력에 관한 정책의 수립ㆍ시행 및 사업 추진에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the formulation and implementation of policies and the promotion of projects regarding inter-Korean cooperation in the forestry sector

rows.source_ko: 7. 남북 산림분야 협력 관련 합의 사항의 이행 지원
rows.text_en: 7. Support for the implementation of agreements regarding inter-Korean cooperation in the forestry sector
⑥ Deleted <July 21, 2023>

[This Article was newly established on Jan. 20, 2012.]
[Title amended on Jan. 24, 2017.]
Article 5-2 Deleted <January 25, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제6조(운영지원과) 운영지원과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Operations Support Division) The Head of the Operations Support Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary of Science and Technology, or Secretary. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>
[Wholly Amended Mar. 3, 2008]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(산림산업정책국) ① 산림산업정책국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원 또는 임업연구관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31., 2017. 1. 24., 2023. 7. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Forest Industry Policy Bureau) ① The Director of the Forest Industry Policy Bureau shall be appointed from among general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service or Forestry Research Officers, provided that the job grade of the position is Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008; Jan. 24, 2017; Jul. 21, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제18조(고위공무원단에 속하는 공무원으로 보하는 직위의 수 등) 국립산림과학원에 고위공무원단에 속하는 공무원으로 보하는 직위 5개(제17조의 고위공무원단 직위를 포함한다)를 두고, 제17조의 고위공무원단 직위를 제외한 고위공무원단에 속하는 공무원으로 보하는 직위의 직무등급은 「책임운영기관의 설치ㆍ운영에 관한 법률」 제10조의 기본운영규정에 표시한다.
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Number of positions to be filled by public officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service, etc.) The National Institute of Forest Science shall have five positions to be filled by public officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service (including the Senior Civil Service positions under Article 17 ), and the job grades of the positions to be filled by public officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service, excluding the Senior Civil Service positions under Article 17, shall be indicated in the basic operational regulations under Article 10 of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Responsible Management Agencies .

rows.source_ko: 제19조(연구소) ①국립산림과학원의 소관 사무를 분장하기 위하여 국립산림과학원장 소속하에 산림기술경영연구소, 산림바이오소재연구소, 난대ㆍ아열대산림연구소 및 산림약용자원연구소를 둔다. <개정 2008. 8. 12., 2012. 7. 26., 2016. 5. 10., 2018. 3. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Research Institutes) ① In order to distribute the affairs under the jurisdiction of the National Institute of Forest Science, the Forest Technology and Management Research Institute, the Forest Biomaterials Research Institute, the Warm Temperate and Subtropical Forest Research Institute, and the Forest Medicinal Resources Research Institute shall be established under the jurisdiction of the Director of the National Institute of Forest Science. <Amended Aug. 12, 2008; Jul. 26, 2012; May 10, 2016; Mar. 30, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ②연구소에 연구소장 1명을 두되, 연구소장은 임업연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2008. 3. 3.>
rows.text_en: ② The Research Institute shall have one Director, who shall be appointed as a Forestry Research Officer. <Amended Mar. 3, 2008>

rows.source_ko: ③연구소장은 국립산림과학원장의 명을 받아 소관 사무를 통할하고, 소속공무원을 지휘ㆍ감독한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Director of the Research Institute shall, under the orders of the Director of the National Institute of Forest Science, oversee affairs under his/her jurisdiction and direct and supervise officials under his/her jurisdiction.
Chapter 7-2 National Arboretum <Newly established Dec. 27, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 제19조의2(국립수목원) 국립수목원에 원장 1명을 두고, 원장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 임기제공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 19-2 (National Arboretum) The National Arboretum shall have one Director, and the Director shall be appointed as a fixed-term public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 27, 2016]
Chapter 8 National Natural Recreation Forest Management Office

rows.source_ko: 제20조(국립자연휴양림관리소) 국립자연휴양림관리소에 소장 1명을 두되, 소장은 임기제 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2008. 3. 3., 2012. 1. 20., 2013. 12. 12.>
rows.text_en: Article 20 (National Natural Recreation Forest Management Office) One Director shall be appointed to the National Natural Recreation Forest Management Office, and the Director shall be appointed as a fixed-term Secretary. <Amended Mar. 3, 2008; Jan. 20, 2012; Dec. 12, 2013>
Chapter 9 Staffing Levels of Public Officials

rows.source_ko: 제21조(산림청에 두는 공무원의 정원) ①산림청에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원(「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제25조제1항에 따른 한시정원은 제외한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다)은 별표 3과 같다. 다만, 「산림청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제32조제1항 단서에 따라 총정원의 10퍼센트를 넘지 않는 범위에서 따로 정하는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 3의2와 같으며, 별표 3의2의 정원 중 15명(행정사무관 또는 임업사무관 2명, 행정주사 또는 임업주사 1명, 행정주사보 또는 임업주사보 6명, 행정주사보ㆍ임업주사보 또는 전산주사보 1명, 전산주사보 1명, 행정서기 또는 임업서기 4명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용한다. <개정 2007. 10. 31., 2009. 4. 30., 2017. 12. 22., 2018. 3. 30., 2019. 8. 23., 2020. 7. 1., 2020. 11. 10., 2021. 7. 30., 2022. 1. 25., 2022. 7. 22., 2023. 7. 21., 2024. 3. 26., 2024. 12. 17., 2025. 7. 29., 2026. 1. 6.>
rows.text_en: Article 21 (Personnel Quotas for Public Officials in the Korea Forest Service) ① The personnel quotas for public officials in the Korea Forest Service by rank (excluding temporary personnel quotas pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies”; hereinafter the same applies in this Article) are as set forth in Table 3. However,the personnel quotas for public officials by rank determined separately within a range not exceeding 10 percent of the total personnel quota pursuant to the proviso of Article 32, Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Korea Forest Service and Its Affiliated Agencies” are as set forth in Table 3-2 , and 15 of the personnel quotas in Table 3-2 (2 Administrative Officers or Forestry Officers, 1 Administrative Assistant or Forestry Assistant, 6 Junior Administrative Assistants or Junior Forestry Assistants, 1 Junior Administrative Assistant, Junior Forestry Assistant, or Junior Computer Assistant, 1 Junior Computer Assistant, and 4 Administrative Clerks or Forestry Clerks) shall be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Amended Oct. 31, 2007; Apr. 30, 2009; Dec. 22, 2017; Mar. 30, 2018; Aug. 23, 2019; Jul. 1, 2020; Nov. 10, 2020; Jul. 30, 2021; Jan. 25, 2022; Jul. 22, 2022; Jul. 21, 2023; Mar. 26, 2024; Dec. 17, 2024; Jul. 29, 2025; Jan. 6, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 산림청에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 홍보업무를 담당하는 1명(4급 또는 5급 1명), 국제통상협력 업무를 담당하는 1명(4급 또는 5급 1명)과 그 밖의 정원 중 7명(4급 1명, 5급 5명, 7급 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있다. <신설 2009. 4. 30., 2012. 7. 26., 2013. 12. 12., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② Among the authorized number of public officials in the Korea Forest Service pursuant to Paragraph 1, one person in charge of public relations (one at Grade 4 or 5) and one person in charge of international trade cooperation (one at Grade 4 or 5), as well as seven persons among the remaining authorized number (one at Grade 4, five at Grade 5, and one at Grade 7), may be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Newly added Apr. 30, 2009; Jul. 26, 2012; Dec. 12, 2013; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 산림청에 두는 공무원 정원 중 공공데이터 관련 업무를 담당하는 1명(5급 1명), 디지털 홍보를 담당하는 1명(6급 1명), 정보보호ㆍ보안을 담당하는 1명(7급 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용한다. <신설 2019. 2. 26., 2023. 12. 26., 2024. 3. 26., 2026. 1. 6.>
rows.text_en: ③ Among the authorized number of public officials in the Korea Forest Service, one person responsible for public data-related duties (Grade 5), one person responsible for digital promotion (Grade 6), and one person responsible for information protection and security (Grade 7) shall be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Newly added Feb. 26, 2019; Dec. 26, 2023; Mar. 26, 2024; Jan. 6, 2026>

rows.text_en: ⑤ The authorized number of public officials by rank in regional forest offices is as set forth in Table 7. rows.text_en: ⑥ The authorized number of public officials by rank assigned to regional forest fire prevention centers is as set forth in Attached Table 7-3 . <Newly added Jan. 6, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑦국립산림과학원에 두는 공무원의 종류별 정원은 별표 8과 같다. 이 경우 4급 공무원의 정원(3급 또는 4급 공무원 정원을 포함한다)은 1명을, 3급 또는 4급 공무원 정원은 4급 공무원의 정원(3급 또는 4급 공무원 정원을 포함한다)의 3분의 1을 각각 그 상한으로 하고, 4급 또는 5급 공무원 정원은 5급 공무원의 정원(4급 또는 5급 공무원 정원을 포함한다)의 3분의 1을 그 상한으로 한다. <개정 2008. 8. 12., 2015. 5. 26., 2026. 1. 6.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The authorized quotas for public officials by type at the National Institute of Forest Science are as set forth in Attached Table 8. In this case, the authorized quota for Grade 4 public officials (including the authorized quota for Grade 3 or Grade 4 public officials) shall be capped at 1 person, and the authorized quota for Grade 3 or Grade 4 public officials shall be capped at one-third of the authorized quota for Grade 4 public officials (including the authorized quota for Grade 3 or Grade 4 public officials); and the authorized quota for Grade 4 or Grade 5 public officials shall be capped at one-third of the authorized quota for Grade 5 public officials (including the authorized quota for Grade 4 or Grade 5 public officials). <Amended Aug. 12, 2008; May 26, 2015; Jan. 6, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑪ 제3항에 따라 산림항공본부에 두는 공무원 정원 중 4급 1명은 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있다. <신설 2023. 8. 30., 2026. 1. 6.>

rows.source_ko: ⑫ 산림청의 소속기관에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 산림항공본부 소속 근로자의 안전ㆍ보건 관리 업무를 담당하는 2명(7급 2명) 및 지방산림청 소속 근로자의 안전ㆍ보건 관리 업무를 담당하는 10명(7급 10명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있다. <신설 2021. 11. 23., 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 3. 26., 2026. 1. 6.>
rows.text_en: ⑫ Among the authorized number of public officials in agencies affiliated with the Korea Forest Service, 2 persons (2 at Grade 7) responsible for the safety and health management of workers belonging to the Forest Aviation Headquarters and 10 persons (10 at Grade 7) responsible for the safety and health management of workers belonging to Regional Forest Offices may be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Newly added Nov. 23, 2021; Aug. 30, 2023; Mar. 26, 2024; Jan. 6, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제22조의2(시간선택제채용공무원 정원의 운영) 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제24조제3항 및 「공무원임용령」 제3조의3제1항에 따라 산림청과 그 소속기관에 두는 시간선택제채용공무원 정원은 산림청과 그 소속기관에 두는 공무원 정원 중 일부를 활용하여 운영할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 22-2 (Operation of Quotas for Part-time Public Officials) Pursuant to Article 24 , Paragraph 3 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Quotas of Administrative Agencies” and Article 3-3, Paragraph 1 of the “Public Officials Appointment Decree,” the quota for part-time public officials to be established in the Korea Forest Service and its affiliated agencies may be operated by utilizing a portion of the quota for public officials to be established in the Korea Forest Service and its affiliated agencies.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(사무직렬 기능직공무원 정원 조정에 따른 특례) 이 규칙에 따라 증원되는 일반직공무원 정원 14명(행정서기 또는 임업서기 7명, 행정서기보 또는 임업서기보 7명)은 대통령령 제21717호 공무원임용령 일부개정령 부칙 제2조에 따라 충원하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Special provisions regarding the adjustment of the number of functional civil servants in the administrative series)  The 14 general civil servant positions to be increased pursuant to this rule (7 administrative clerks or forestry clerks, and 7 assistant administrative clerks or assistant forestry clerks) shall be filled in accordance with Article 2 of the Addenda to the Partial Amendment to the Public Officials Appointment Decree, Presidential Decree No. 21717.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(사무직렬 기능직공무원 정원 감축에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행으로 감축되는 기능직공무원의 정원 14명(기능9급 1명, 기능10급 13명)의 초과현원은 증원되는 일반직공무원 정원 14명(행정서기 또는 임업서기 7명, 행정서기보 또는 임업서기보 7명)이 모두 충원될 때까지 해당 일반직공무원의 정원을 대체하여 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Reduction of Quotas for Technical Civil Servants in the Administrative Series)  The excess number of technical civil servants exceeding the quota of 14 (1 Grade 9 Technical Civil Servant and 13 Grade 10 Technical Civil Servants) reduced by the enforcement of this Rule shall be deemed to be replacing the quota of the relevant general civil servants until the quota of 14 general civil servants to be increased (7 Administrative Clerks or Forestry Clerks, and 7 Assistant Administrative Clerks or Assistant Forestry Clerks) is fully filled.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(정원에 관한 경과조치) 대통령령 제24976호 산림청과 그 소속기관 직제 일부개정령 및 대통령령 제24983호 책임운영기관의 설치ㆍ운영에 관한 법률 시행령 일부개정령 시행에 따른 초과현원으로서 이 규칙에 따른 정원을 초과하는 현원 15명(5급 1명, 6급 4명, 7급 2명, 8급 1명, 9급 6명, 연구사 1명)은 그 초과된 현원이 이 규칙에 따른 정원과 일치될 때까지 그에 상응하는 정원이 산림청과 그 소속기관에 따로 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Personnel Quotas)  As for the 15 personnel (1 Grade 5, 4 Grade 6, 2 Grade 7, 1 Grade 8, 6 Grade 9, and 1 Researcher) exceeding the personnel quota under this Rule pursuant to the enforcement of Presidential Decree No. 24976, Partial Amendment to the Organizational Structure of the Korea Forest Service and Its Affiliated Agencies, and Presidential Decree No. 24983, Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Responsible Management Agencies, the corresponding personnel quota shall be deemed to exist separately within the Korea Forest Service and its affiliated agencies until the excess personnel quota matches the personnel quota under this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(기능직 폐지에 따른 정원 조정에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행으로 기능직공무원 정원을 감축하여 증원되는 일반직공무원 정원 중 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제26조제2항 및 제3항에 따라 통합ㆍ운영하던 정원이 있는 경우에, 그 통합ㆍ운영하던 직급에 근속승진 임용된 공무원에 대해서는 해당 직급에 재직하는 동안에는 별표 3, 별표 3의2, 별표 4부터 별표 6까지, 별표 6의2, 별표 6의3, 별표 7, 별표 7의2, 별표 8, 별표 9 및 별표 9의2의 개정규정에도 불구하고 그 정원이 산림청과 그 소속기관에 따로 있는 것으로 보고, 그에 해당하는 종전 직급의 정원은 감축된 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Adjustment of Personnel Quotas Following the Abolition of Functional Positions)  In cases where there are personnel quotas for general civil servants that were integrated and operated pursuant to Article 26, Paragraphs 2 and 3 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies” among the personnel quotas for general civil servants that are increased by reducing the personnel quotas for functional civil servants due to the enforcement of this Rule, for civil servants appointed by promotion based on seniority to the integrated and operated ranks, notwithstanding the amended provisions of Annex 3, Annex 3-2, Annex 4 through 6, Annex 6-2, Annex 6-3, Annex 7, Annex 7-2, Annex 8, Annex 9, and Annex 9-2, such personnel quotas shall be deemed to exist separately within the Korea Forest Service and its affiliated agencies while they are serving in the relevant ranks, and the personnel quotas for the corresponding former ranks shall be deemed to have been reduced.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(관리운영직군 공무원의 정원 감원에 따른 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행으로 감원되는 지방산림청의 관리운영직군 공무원 정원 1명(8급 1명)에 해당하는 관리운영직군 공무원의 초과 현원이 있는 경우에는 2021년 12월 31일까지 그 초과현원에 상응하는 정원이 이 규칙 시행으로 증원되는 기술직군 공무원 정원 1명(8급 1명)의 정원을 대체하여 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Following the Reduction in Quotas for Public Officials in the Management and Operations Job Group) If  there is an excess number of public officials in the management and operations job group corresponding to the quota of one person (one Grade 8) of public officials in the management and operations job group of a Regional Forest Office that is reduced due to the enforcement of this Rule, the quota corresponding to such excess number of people shall be deemed to have replaced the quota of one person (one Grade 8) of public officials in the technical job group that is increased due to the enforcement of this Rule until December 31, 2021.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 518, Jan. 25, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 증원한 정원의 존속기한) 이 규칙 시행으로 증원되는 별표 3의2의 정원 1명(전산주사보 1명)은 2027년 1월 24일까지 존속한다. <개정 2024. 12. 17.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Staffing Increase under the Total Personnel Cost System)  The staffing quota of one person (one Assistant Computer Officer) specified in Annex 3-2, which is increased by the enforcement of this Rule, shall remain in effect until January 24, 2027. <Amended Dec. 17, 2024>
ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 522, Feb. 22, 2022>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 541, July 22, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Article 2  Deleted <July 21, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(총액인건비제로 증원한 정원의 존속기한) 종전의 농림축산식품부령 제390호 산림청과 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙 일부개정령 부칙 제3조제1항에 따른 정원으로서, 이 규칙 시행으로 감축되는 정원 1명(행정사무관 또는 임업사무관 1명)을 제외한 별표 3의2의 정원 1명(행정사무관 또는 임업사무관 1명)은 2027년 7월 31일까지 존속한다. <개정 2025. 7. 29.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Duration of Personnel Quotas Increased under the Total Personnel Cost System) Of the positions under Article 3, Paragraph 1 of the Addenda to the former Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 390 partially amending the Enforcement Rules on the Organization of the Korea Forest Service and Its Affiliated Agencies, the remaining one Grade 5 administrative or forestry position in Attached Table 3-2, excluding the one Grade 5 administrative or forestry position reduced by the enforcement of these Rules, shall remain in effect until July 31, 2027. <Amended July 29, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제4조(정원에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행으로 감축되는 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있는 정원 1명(5급 1명)에 해당하는 초과현원이 있는 경우에는 2022년 7월 31일까지 그 초과현원에 상응하는 정원이 산림청에 따로 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Transitional Measures Concerning Personnel Quotas)  If there is an excess number of personnel corresponding to the quota of one fixed-term public official (one Grade 5 official) that can be appointed due to the enforcement of this Rule, the quota corresponding to such excess personnel shall be deemed to exist separately within the Korea Forest Service until July 31, 2022.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 557, Dec. 20, 2022>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on December 22, 2022.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 상향 조정한 직급의 존속기한) ① 이 규칙 시행으로 직급이 상향 조정되는 별표 6의2의 정원 2명(방송통신주사 1명, 운전주사 1명)은 2027년 12월 21일까지 존속하며, 2027년 12월 22일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 정원은 별표 6의2의 방송통신서기보 1명, 운전서기보 1명으로 각각 본다. <개정 2025. 12. 19.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Positions Upgraded Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The authorized quota of two positions (one Broadcasting and Telecommunications Chief Clerk and one Driver Chief Clerk) specified in Annex 6-2, which is upgraded in rank pursuant to the enforcement of this Rule, shall remain in effect until December 21, 2027; thereafter, the corresponding authorized quota shall be deemed to be one Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistant Clerk and one Driver Assistant Clerk, respectively, as specified in Annex 6-2. <Amended Dec. 19, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 이 규칙 시행으로 직급이 상향 조정되는 별표 7의2의 정원 10명(운전주사 5명, 방송통신주사보 5명)은 2027년 12월 21일까지 존속하며, 2027년 12월 22일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 정원은 별표 7의2의 운전서기보 5명, 방송통신서기 1명 및 방송통신서기보 4명으로 각각 본다. <개정 2025. 12. 19.>
rows.text_en: ② The quota of 10 positions (5 Driving Chief Clerks and 5 Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistant Chief Clerks) specified in Attached Table 7-2, whose ranks are upgraded by the enforcement of this Rule, shall remain in effect until December 21, 2027; thereafter, the corresponding quota shall be deemed to be 5 Driving Assistant Clerks, 1 Broadcasting and Telecommunications Clerk, and 4 Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistant Clerks, respectively, as specified in Attached Table 7-2. <Amended Dec. 19, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(총액인건비제로 증원한 정원의 존속기한) ① 이 규칙 시행으로 증원되는 별표 3의2의 정원 2명(행정서기 또는 임업서기 2명)은 2027년 12월 21일까지 존속한다. <개정 2025. 12. 19.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Duration of Staffing Increase under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The two additional positions (two Administrative Clerks or Forestry Clerks) specified in Annex 3-2, added pursuant to the enforcement of this Rule, shall remain in effect until December 21, 2027. <Amended Dec. 19, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 이 규칙 시행으로 증원되는 별표 7의2의 정원 7명(행정서기 또는 임업서기 7명)은 2027년 12월 21일까지 존속한다. <개정 2025. 12. 19.>
rows.text_en: ② The seven additional positions (seven administrative clerks or forestry clerks) specified in Annex 7-2, added pursuant to the enforcement of this Rule, shall remain in effect until December 21, 2027. <Amended Dec. 19, 2025>
[Wholly Amended July 29, 2025]
ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 558, Dec. 29, 2022>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 561, Jan. 13, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 신설한 기구의 존속기한) ① 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조에 따라 이 규칙 시행으로 신설되는 산림빅데이터팀, 임업직불제팀 및 중앙산림재난상황실은 각각 2028년 1월 12일까지 존속한다. <개정 2025. 12. 19.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Organizations Newly Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The Forest Big Data Team, the Forestry Direct Payment System Team, and the Central Forest Disaster Situation Room, newly established pursuant to Article 29 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies upon the enforcement of this Rule, shall each remain in existence until January 12, 2028. <Amended Dec. 19, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 산림빅데이터팀장이 기획조정관을 보좌하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 제1항에 따른 존속기한이 지난 날부터 산림빅데이터팀장이 보좌하는 사항은 산림디지털담당관이 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ② Unless special provisions are made regarding matters in which the Head of the Forest Big Data Team assists the Director General for Planning and Coordination until the expiration date under Paragraph 1, the matters in which the Head of the Forest Big Data Team assists shall be assisted by the Forest Digital Officer starting from the day after the expiration date under Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 임업직불제팀장 및 중앙산림재난상황실장이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 제1항에 따른 존속기한이 지난 날부터 임업직불제팀장이 분장하는 사항은 사유림경영소득과장이, 중앙산림재난상황실장이 분장하는 사항은 산불방지과장이 각각 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ If no special provisions are made by the expiration date under Paragraph 1 concerning the matters assigned to the Head of the Forestry Direct Payment System Team and the Head of the Central Forest Disaster Situation Room, from the following day the matters assigned to the Head of the Forestry Direct Payment System Team shall be handled by the Head of the Private Forest Management Income Division, and the matters assigned to the Head of the Central Forest Disaster Situation Room shall be handled by the Head of the Forest Fire Prevention Division.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 564, Feb. 23, 2023>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 576, Apr. 11, 2023> (Enforcement Rule of the Erosion Control Act)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(다른 법령의 개정) 산림청과 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Amendment of Other Laws)  The Enforcement Rules for the Organization of the Korea Forest Service and its Affiliated Agencies are partially amended as follows:
In Article 9, Paragraph 7, Subparagraph 7, “Erosion Control Association” shall be changed to “Korea Erosion Control Technology Association.”
ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 598, July 21, 2023>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on July 22, 2023.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 신설한 기구의 존속기한) ① 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」제29조에 따라 이 규칙 시행으로 신설되는 임업수출교역팀 및 산림안전보건일자리팀은 각각 2028년 7월 21일까지 존속한다. <개정 2026. 7. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Organizations Newly Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The Forestry Export & Trade Team and the Forest Safety & Health Jobs Team, newly established pursuant to Article 29 of the General Rules on the Organization and Staffing of Administrative Agencies, shall each remain in existence until July 21, 2028. <Amended July 22, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 임업수출교역팀장이 국제산림협력관을 보좌하는 사항 및 산림안전보건일자리팀장이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 제1항에 따른 존속기한이 지난 날부터 임업수출교역팀장이 보좌하는 사항은 해외자원담당관이 보좌하고, 산림안전보건일자리팀장이 분장하는 사항은 산림복지정책과장이 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② If no special provisions are established regarding matters in which the Head of the Forestry Export & Trade Team assists the Director General for International Forestry Cooperation and matters assigned by the Head of the Forest Safety, Health & Jobs Team until the expiration of the term of existence under Paragraph 1, then from the day after the expiration of the term of existence under Paragraph 1, the Overseas Resources Officer shall assist in matters assisted by the Head of the Forestry Export & Trade Team, and the Head of the Forest Welfare Policy Division shall assume matters assigned by the Head of the Forest Safety, Health & Jobs Team.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 606, Aug. 30, 2023>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 623, Dec. 26, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만 별표 1 및 별표 2의 개정규정은 2024년 1월 18일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the amended provisions of Annex 1 and Annex 2 shall enter into force on January 18, 2024.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 신설한 기구의 존속기한) ① 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조에 따라 이 규칙 시행으로 신설되는 숲길등산레포츠팀은 2026년 12월 25일까지 존속한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Organizations Newly Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The Forest Trail Hiking & Leisure Sports Team newly established under the enforcement of this rule pursuant to Article 29 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies” shall exist until December 25, 2026.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 숲길등산레포츠팀장이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 같은 항에 따른 존속기한의 다음 날부터 숲길등산레포츠팀장이 분장하는 사항은 산림휴양치유과장이 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② If no special provisions are made by the expiration date under Paragraph 1 regarding the duties assigned to the Head of the Forest Trail Hiking and Leisure Sports Team, those duties shall be performed by the Head of the Forest Recreation and Healing Division from the day after that expiration date.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 641, Mar. 26, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Article 2  Deleted <December 17, 2024>
Article 3  Deleted <December 17, 2024>
ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 674, July 25, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 다음 각 호의 사항은 2024년 8월 1일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the matters of each of the following subparagraphs shall enter into force on August 1, 2024.

rows.source_ko: 1. 별표 3의2의 개정규정[정원 2명(행정주사보 또는 임업주사보 2명)의 감원 및 정원 2명(행정주사보 또는 임업주사보 2명)의 증원 부분으로 한정한다]
rows.text_en: 1. Amended provisions of Attached Table 3-2 [limited to the reduction of the authorized quota by 2 positions (2 Administrative Assistants or Forestry Assistants) and the increase of the authorized quota by 2 positions (2 Administrative Assistants or Forestry Assistants)]

rows.source_ko: 2. 부칙 제2조제1항[정원 2명(행정주사보 또는 임업주사보 2명)의 감원 부분으로 한정한다]
rows.text_en: 2. Article 2, Paragraph 1 of the Addenda [Limited to the reduction of the authorized quota by 2 positions (2 Administrative Assistants or Forestry Assistants)]
3. Article 2, Paragraph 2 of the Addenda

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 증원한 정원의 존속기한) ① 종전의 농림축산식품부령 제488호 산림청과 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙 일부개정령(농림축산식품부령 제541호 산림청과 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙 일부개정령에 따라 개정된 내용을 포함한다) 부칙 제3조제1항에 따른 정원으로서 별표 3의2의 개정규정에 따라 감원되는 정원 2명(행정주사보 또는 임업주사보 2명)을 제외한 별표 3의2의 정원 4명(행정사무관 또는 임업사무관 1명, 행정주사보 또는 임업주사보 2명, 행정주사보ㆍ임업주사보 또는 전산주사보 1명)은 2027년 7월 31일까지 존속한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of personnel quota increased under the total personnel cost system)  ① The four remaining positions in Attached Table 3-2 under Article 3, Paragraph 1 of the Addenda to the former Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 488, Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules of the Organizational Structure of the Korea Forest Service and Its Affiliated Agencies (including the contents amended pursuant to the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 541, Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules of the Organizational Structure of the Korea Forest Service and Its Affiliated Agencies), excluding the 2 personnel quota (2 Assistant Administrative Officers or Assistant Forestry Officers) reduced pursuant to the amended provisions of Table 3-2, shall remain in effect until July 31, 2027.

rows.source_ko: ② 이 규칙 시행으로 증원되는 별표 3의2의 정원 2명(행정주사보 또는 임업주사보 2명)은 2027년 7월 31일까지 존속한다.
rows.text_en: ② The two additional positions (two administrative assistants or forestry assistants) specified in Annex 3-2, which are increased by the enforcement of this rule, shall remain in effect until July 31, 2027.

rows.source_ko: [시행일: 2024. 8. 1.] 제2조제1항[정원 2명(행정주사보 또는 임업주사보 2명)의 감원 부분으로 한정한다], 제2조제2항
rows.text_en: [Effective Date: Aug. 1, 2024] Article 2, Paragraph 1 [limited to the reduction of the authorized quota by 2 positions (2 Administrative Assistants or Forestry Assistants)], Article 2, Paragraph 2
ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 696, Dec. 17, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 제27조 및 별표 11의 개정규정은 2025년 1월 1일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the amended provisions of Article 27 and Annex 11 shall enter into force on January 1, 2025.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 신설한 기구의 존속기한) ① 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조에 따라 이 규칙 시행으로 신설되는 운영재산관리팀은 2027년 7월 31일까지 존속한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Organizations Newly Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The Operational Property Management Team newly established under the enforcement of this rule pursuant to Article 29 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies” shall remain in existence until July 31, 2027.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 운영재산관리팀장이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 같은 항에 따른 존속기한의 다음 날부터 운영재산관리팀장이 분장하는 사항은 지방산림청 산림재난안전과장이 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② If no special provisions are made regarding the matters assigned by the Head of the Operational Property Management Team until the expiration date under Paragraph 1, the matters assigned by the Head of the Operational Property Management Team shall be assigned by the Head of the Forest Disaster and Safety Division of the Regional Forest Office from the day following the expiration date under the same paragraph.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(총액인건비제로 증원한 정원의 존속기한) 이 규칙 시행으로 증원되는 별표 3의2의 정원 1명(행정주사보 또는 임업주사보 1명)은 2027년 7월 31일까지 존속한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Duration of the number of personnel increased under the total personnel cost system)  The number of personnel (one administrative assistant or forestry assistant) specified in Annex 3-2, which is increased by the enforcement of this rule, shall remain in effect until July 31, 2027.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(총액인건비제로 상향 조정한 직급의 존속기한) ① 이 규칙 시행으로 직급이 상향 조정되는 별표 5의2의 정원 1명(서기관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 임업사무관)은 2027년 3월 31일까지 존속하고, 2027년 4월 1일 이후 그에 해당하는 정원은 별표 5의2의 정원 중 행정사무관 또는 임업사무관 1명으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Duration of Positions Upgraded to the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The one authorized position (Senior Secretary, Senior Secretary of Science and Technology, Administrative Officer, or Forestry Officer) specified in Annex 5-2, whose position is upgraded by the enforcement of this Rule, shall remain in effect until March 31, 2027, and thereafter, the corresponding authorized position shall be deemed to be one Administrative Officer or Forestry Officer among the authorized positions specified in Annex 5-2.

rows.source_ko: ② 이 규칙 시행으로 직급이 상향 조정되는 별표 7의2의 정원 3명(행정사무관 또는 임업사무관 3명)은 2027년 7월 31일까지 존속하고, 2027년 8월 1일 이후 그에 해당하는 정원 3명은 별표 7의2의 정원 중 행정주사 또는 임업주사 3명으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ② The three positions (three Administrative Officers or Forestry Officers) specified in Annex 7-2, whose ranks are adjusted upwards due to the enforcement of this rule, shall remain in effect until July 31, 2027, and the corresponding three positions thereafter shall be deemed as three Administrative Assistants or Forestry Assistants among the positions specified in Annex 7-2.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 705, Feb. 25, 2025>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 730, July 29, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 증원한 정원의 존속기한) ① 종전의 농림축산식품부령 제488호 산림청과 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙 일부개정령 부칙 제3조제2항에 따른 정원으로서, 이 규칙 시행으로 감축되는 정원 1명(행정주사보 또는 임업주사보 1명)을 제외한 별표 3의2의 정원 1명(행정주사 또는 임업주사 1명)은 2027년 7월 29일까지 존속한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Personnel Quotas Increased under the Total Personnel Cost System) ① Of the positions under Article 3, Paragraph 2 of the Addenda to the former Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 488 partially amending the Enforcement Rules on the Organization of the Korea Forest Service and Its Affiliated Agencies, excluding the one Grade 7 administrative or forestry position reduced by the enforcement of these Rules, the remaining one Grade 6 administrative or forestry position in Attached Table 3-2 shall remain in effect until July 29, 2027.

rows.source_ko: ② 이 규칙 시행으로 증원되는 별표 3의2의 정원 1명(행정서기 또는 임업서기 1명)은 2028년 7월 28일까지 존속한다.
rows.text_en: ② The one additional position (one administrative clerk or forestry clerk) specified in Annex 3-2, which is increased by the enforcement of this rule, shall remain in effect until July 28, 2028.

This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 743, Dec. 19, 2025>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 신설한 기구의 존속기한) ① 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조에 따라 이 규칙 시행으로 신설되는 임도관리팀은 2029년 1월 5일까지 존속한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Organizations Newly Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The Forest Road Management Team newly established under the enforcement of this rule pursuant to Article 29 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies” shall remain in existence until January 5, 2029.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 임도관리팀장이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 같은 항에 따른 존속기한의 다음 날부터 임도관리팀장이 분장하는 사항은 목재산업과장이 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② If no special provisions are made regarding the matters assigned by the Head of the Forest Road Management Team until the expiration date under Paragraph 1, the matters assigned by the Head of the Forest Road Management Team shall be assigned by the Head of the Timber Industry Division from the day following the expiration date under the same paragraph.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(총액인건비제로 증원한 정원의 존속기한) 이 규칙 시행으로 증원되는 별표 3의2의 정원 2명(행정주사보 또는 임업주사보 1명, 행정서기 또는 임업서기 1명)은 2029년 1월 5일까지 존속한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Duration of personnel quota increased under the total personnel cost system)  The two personnel quota specified in Annex 3-2 (one administrative assistant or forestry assistant, and one administrative clerk or forestry clerk) increased by the enforcement of this rule shall remain in effect until January 5, 2029.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 755, Feb. 19, 2026>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 757, Feb. 27, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 하향 조정한 직급의 존속기한) ① 이 규칙 시행으로 조정되는 별표 6의2의 임업서기 30명 중 2명은 2026년 7월 31일까지 존속하며 2026년 8월 1일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 정원은 별표 6의2의 임업주사 1명 및 임업주사보 1명으로 보고, 임업서기 30명 중 17명은 2027년 3월 31일까지 존속하며 2027년 4월 1일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 정원은 별표 6의2의 임업주사 3명 및 임업주사보 14명으로 보며, 임업서기 30명 중 11명은 2027년 12월 31일까지 존속하며 2028년 1월 1일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 정원은 별표 6의2의 임업주사보 11명으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Positions Downwardly Adjusted to the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① Of the 30 Forestry Clerks specified in Annex 6-2 adjusted by the enforcement of this Rule, 2 shall remain in effect until July 31, 2026, and after August 1, 2026, the corresponding authorized quota shall be deemed to be 1 Forestry Chief Clerk and 1 Forestry Assistant Chief Clerk as specified in Annex 6-2; 17 of the 30 Forestry Clerks shall remain in effect until March 31, 2027, and after April 1, 2027, the corresponding authorized quota shall be deemed to be 3 Forestry Chief Clerks and 14 Forestry Assistant Chief Clerks as specified in Annex 6-2; and 11 of the 30 Forestry Clerks shall remain in effect until December 31, 2027, and after January 1, 2028, the corresponding authorized quota shall be deemed to be 11 Forestry Assistant Chief Clerks as specified in Annex 6-2.

rows.source_ko: ② 이 규칙 시행으로 조정되는 별표 7의2의 임업서기 2명은 2027년 3월 31일까지 존속하며, 2027년 4월 1일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 정원은 별표 7의2의 임업주사 2명으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ② The two Forestry Clerks specified in Annex 7-2, adjusted by the enforcement of this Rule, shall remain in effect until March 31, 2027, and from April 1, 2027, the corresponding authorized number shall be deemed to be two Forestry Junior Officers specified in Annex 7-2.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 781, July 22, 2026>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
